newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises led by power utility CEZ.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises led by power utility CEZ.

text.p: The Czech PX50, boosted by major issues in continuous trading, resumed its bull run on Tuesday rising 0.7 percent to 595.1.
Power utility CEZ, one of the biggest gainers since the beginning of the year, led the way with a 2.2 percent rise to 1,229 and dealers said that the issue still had upside potential.
"There's been lots of positive research published on CEZ...I think there are still potential buying opportunities," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
Vystavel added that there had been much interest in CEZ from abroad where CEZ is commonly seen as a cheap way to get into Czech blue chips.
SPT Telecom also pushed ahead. The issue rose 1.35 percent to 3,750. Komercni Banka was unchanged at 2,620.
The above four issues, which account for 45 percent of the PX50's capitalisation, were all down at the morning price fixing.
In the broader market, the largest Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna was the strongest gainer. Pojistovna rose 168 crowns to 3,541.
Brewing stocks Prazske Pivovary (PP) and Radegast posted moderate gains. PP was up 21 crowns to 2,521 and Ragegast rose 50 crowns to 4,700.
